scope: Risks for a future Concept 8B implementation only; no product changes were made during this audit.

risks.risk: Rail flyout selection sets a tool inconsistent with activeTool, activeStage, drawerMode, or drawerOpen.
risks.impact: Wrong tool content, stale stage highlight, or drawer unexpectedly closing.
risks.mitigation: Keep App's activeTool as the source of selected tool; derive active stage from the existing WORKSPACE_TOOLS entry; keep navigation state UI-only.
verify: Tool selection while drawer is closed

risks.risk: A programmatic destination begins requiring an extra user click in the flyout.
risks.impact: Existing RF-result, path-profile, Run-history, report, and attention workflows regress.
risks.mitigation: Keep selectWorkspaceTool/openResults/openPathProfileDiagnostics and source actions as direct state transitions that bypass menu selection.

risks.risk: Unavailable tools disappear or lose their reason/badges in a vertical menu.
risks.impact: Users cannot discover features or understand why Interference/Core is not selectable.
risks.mitigation: Render every stage tool from the shared metadata; pass App-owned availability, reason, success, and warning state to the flyout.

risks.risk: Opening a stage menu or building registry metadata eagerly imports a lazy feature.
risks.impact: Bundle cost and safe lazy boundaries from Concept 7I regress.
risks.mitigation: Menu consumes labels/icons/descriptive metadata only. Do not store executable import functions in the registry. Selection continues through existing lazy boundaries.

risks.risk: Flyout traps focus, uses inaccurate aria-expanded state, fails Escape, or returns focus to an unmounted tab.
risks.impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users lose their place or cannot find tools.
risks.mitigation: Use explicit expanded state; follow one keyboard model; restore focus to stage trigger on Escape; focus active tool heading after selection; ensure drawer close returns to a mounted stage button.

risks.risk: Popover blocks drawer/map clicks, opens only on hover, or cannot be operated by touch.
risks.impact: Pointer/touch users lose map interaction or tool selection.
risks.mitigation: Click must open; hover may assist only. Dismiss outside without swallowing the intended click. Use a sheet selector below 640 px.

risks.risk: Removing tabs also removes visible current-tool and stage identity.
risks.impact: Users lose orientation after direct destination or stage switch.
risks.mitigation: Keep drawer icon/title/subtitle and active stage rail state; ensure title remains readable on phone.

risks.risk: Grouping hides Project/Scenario/Version/draft identity or collapses currentness into a color/dot.
risks.impact: Users cannot tell which plan or result they are inspecting.
risks.mitigation: Keep all names/Version-or-no-Version, draft, explicit result state, and short source Run answerable in the persistent header; details disclosure is for full IDs.

risks.risk: Compact persistence display confuses browser-local draft autosave with immutable Version save.
risks.impact: Users may believe a Version exists or that local data was not saved.
risks.mitigation: Keep Version label in Workspace identity and local autosave as a separate, clearly named state.

risks.risk: Flyout, nested rail, or command-bar group changes resize map or overflow narrow layouts.
risks.impact: Spatial planning loses map visibility and immediate feedback.
risks.mitigation: Flyout overlays, does not reflow. Keep drawer width. Use existing responsive structure and one-sheet mobile chooser.

risks.risk: Moving global metrics makes current result less discoverable or loses active-layer source.
risks.impact: Users cannot find score or judge whether map is historical/stale.
risks.mitigation: Retain a global Result state/source chip to open Results; keep metrics in Results; keep source in the map legend only while layer is visible.

risks.risk: Removing selected stage tabs loses success/warning/count badges and attention jumps.
risks.impact: Users miss unavailable state, results, or validation needs.
risks.mitigation: Carry tool-level badges/reasons into flyout and stage aggregate; programmatic attention jumps bypass it.

risks.risk: Removing shared tabs accidentally removes Results' RF/Optimization/Interference/Compare/Candidates subviews.
risks.mitigation: Remove only WORKSPACE_TOOLS sibling row; do not conflate it with tool-internal result-view tabs or capability disclosures.

risks.risk: Grouping the command bar hides or changes Run Sector/Evaluate Network semantics/readiness.
risks.impact: User may evaluate the wrong plan or be unable to compute.
risks.mitigation: Preserve exact mode-aware labels, disabled rules, and placement in existing Plan/Simulate scope; keep tool-specific actions local.

risks.risk: Navigation work expands into map toolbar/style, RF, optimizer, persistence, or route architecture.
risks.impact: Concept 8A's bounded structural hypothesis becomes hard to verify.
risks.mitigation: Keep 8B focused on rail/tool navigation and command-bar grouping. Defer map toolbar to 8C. Keep all domain and persistence code invariant.

invarianceContract.navigationState: UI-only; do not persist stage/tool choice without separate evidence.
